## Context / Problem

Discovered from majestic-depilatory-beetle. The advisory `sweep (windows)` job runs a maintained subset held green: tests known to fail on Windows are deselected through `.github/windows-sweep-deselect/unclassified.args`. This bug owns that file: 242 tests in 100 modules, from the 5 scheduled runs at `b4e0d01b649` (2026-11-15/16).

These failed on Windows with assertion-level messages that match none of the signatures used for the other classes (MAX_PATH, POSIX shell, text encoding, POSIX permissions, path separators, POSIX APIs, nested-pytest plugins, literal `/tmp`, file locks). Largest modules: `tests/unit/test_gate_admission_09da.py` (12), `tests/interfaces/store/test_ensure_drift_matrix.py` (10), `tests/unit/test_compact_trigger.py` (8), `tests/unit/test_makefile_worktree.py` (8), `tests/scripts/graph/test_doctor_locks.py` (7), `tests/unit/test_rebar_debug_step7_class_review.py` (7). Some may be downstream of the larger classes (for example a git or path failure surfacing as an assertion).

## Re-measure (2026-11-19 PST)
Throwaway branch `tmp/w05-remeasure` ran exactly the 242 `unclassified.args` entries on Windows against origin/main `717c50f8b33` code (run 44665461131): 48 passed, 194 failed or errored. Run 44681457334 repeated the 194 with JUnit XML; every failure's full traceback was read and assigned one root-cause class. Locale and autocrlf were also reproduced on macOS (`LC_ALL=en_US.ISO8859-1 PYTHONUTF8=0`; `GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL` with `core.autocrlf=true`). Per-class evidence is on each class bug.
- 48 pass: their lines are removed.
- 14 are fixed by dogtired-blank-fieldmouse (subprocess output decoded with the locale codec): removed once that change is on main and a sweep run confirms them.
- 180 move to class files, each owned by a bug linked `discovered_from` this one:
- `pid-liveness.args` (14): smoking-bereft-boar
- `detached-maintenance.args` (13): uncommon-cleansable-wren
- `posix-api.args` (15): aerial-flameproof-antbear
- `posix-shell-stubs.args` (55): transhuman-wounded-pangolin
- `path-separators.args` (41): foldable-gaseous-owl
- `crlf.args` (11): neglectful-acceptable-gerbil
- `locale-tests.args` (20): dear-advanced-azurevase
- `store-history.args` (11): cold-censorable-armedcrab

## Approach
After dogtired-blank-fieldmouse merges: create the 8 class files above (sorted, LF, one `--deselect=` per line), add each as an `'@...'` argument of the `sweep (windows)` suite command in `.github/workflows/test.yml`, and delete `unclassified.args` and its reference. Before pushing, a throwaway-branch Windows run of the new selection against the then-current main confirms the 48 and the 14 pass and that the sweep concludes success apart from tests owned by other open tickets.

## Scope
- `.github/windows-sweep-deselect/unclassified.args` (deleted)
- `.github/windows-sweep-deselect/<class>.args` (8 new files)
- `.github/workflows/test.yml` (argument-file references)

## Testing
`tests/unit/test_windows_sweep_deselect.py` checks the files and the command stay in step (every file referenced, sorted, unique, LF, no test in two classes, every module exists); `make verify` runs it. Windows: the throwaway run above, then a `sweep (windows)` run on main after the merge.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Each remaining entry's root cause is recorded on this ticket or the class bug it moved to.
- [x] Every line removed from `unclassified.args` names a test that passed in a `sweep (windows)` run on main after the fix, or now sits in another class file (run id recorded in a comment).
- [x] `sweep (windows)` concludes `success` on that run.
